title: Extract provider protocol DTO and response parser modules from concrete adapters
description: Concrete provider adapters now combine config, HTTP calls, payload DTOs, content-part conversion, SSE parsing, error parsing, and response mapping. TASK-014 covers shared HTTP helpers; this task keeps protocol-specific DTO/parsing logic local but out of the adapter orchestration files.

files.change: Move chat completion request/response content normalization and SSE event parsing out of the adapter.
Move generateContent DTOs, data URL image conversion, finish-reason mapping, and content extraction.
Move request DTOs, SSE audio collection, and hex decoding helpers.

criteria: Provider-specific payload decisions stay in provider/protocol modules, not in generic HTTP helpers.
Concrete adapter files mostly orchestrate config, request send, and trait implementation.
Existing provider tests and inline parser tests still pass.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-provider && cargo clippy -p astrbot-provider -- -D warnings
